owner: integration repository (not the frozen sources/ondevice_ai snapshot)
rationale: Weights follow current evidence maturity, not the legacy V4 0.35/0.35/0.15/0.15 split.
The overall risk formula still fuses mmWave, CO2, PIR, and thermal into R. It publishes NORMAL, DANGER, or EMERGENCY. It does not publish WARNING.
WARNING is a separate CO2-only caution formula. mmWave, PIR, and thermal can raise R and DANGER/EMERGENCY, but they cannot raise caution.

The retired absolute caution trip was warning_ppm 1500 (Indoor Air Quality Control Act enforcement-rule Table 2 footnote). A sealed room can idle near or above 1500 ppm, so that ceiling produced all-day WARNING. Table 2 default 1000 ppm was already not a live trip; field idle is about 1184 ppm.

The only remaining absolute CO2 ppm trip is immediate_danger_ppm 5000. When presence_detected is true it is the emergency override (OSHA PEL / NIOSH REL / ACGIH TLV 8-hour TWA number used as a team instantaneous emergency, not a certified occupational average). When presence is unconfirmed or vacant, 5000 ppm is demoted to CO2 WARNING. danger_ppm 2500 is retired; it no longer floors DANGER or WARNING.

DANGER and EMERGENCY require risk.presence_detected == true. Unconfirmed (presence_available is not true, presence_source UNCONFIRMED, or presence_detected is not true) and vacant rooms may only publish NORMAL or CO2 WARNING. Occupancy C-B6 does not gate this: localizing sets occupancy_available false and must not hide a confirmed person. Person-side floors (thermal fall, mmWave apnea, R>=65) are suppressed until presence is true.
After the 180 s source-clock median lock, caution enters when plus-only delta from the locked first value B reaches 500 ppm and clears at 350 ppm. Occupancy C-B6 stays risk_semantic NONE.

After lock, caution also accepts the canonical 150 s CO2 slope: 50 ppm/min raises co2_fast_rise. Slope caution does not fire while localizing, and the short local endpoint fallback cannot raise WARNING. 15 ppm/min remains a score bonus on R only.

The active public-SDT FP32 thermal model only decides person vs empty. Standing/sitting vs lying is the bbox overlay (taller-or-square → HUMAN_NORMAL score 0.0, wider → HUMAN_FALL_PROXY score 0.4). Neural pose is not a risk input. HUMAN_FALL_PROXY remains a bounded posture proxy and cannot assert a real fall or emergency.
mmWave neural output is OBSERVE_ONLY. Unverified APNEA-proxy may score when TRUSTED, but it cannot raise caution. Only hardware-verified apnea is DANGER.
PIR is corroborating only and is unavailable, not zero, when presence is unconfirmed. Long no-motion scores R but does not raise caution.
A weighted sum alone dilutes a single severe hazard, so per-signal escalation floors are applied on top of the score.
Reporting NORMAL from a small fraction of the sensor set is unsafe, so an evidence-sufficiency gate emits INDETERMINATE instead.
formula: R = 100 * sum(w_i * s_i for available i) / sum(w_i for available i); overall = DANGER if occupied and R >= danger_min else NORMAL; caution = WARNING if locked and (delta>=500 or canonical-slope>=50), or vacant 5000 ppm; DANGER/EMERGENCY require presence_detected; level = max(overall, caution, danger_floors, emergency)

ai_acceptance.comment: A 3-class thermal head near uniform output is not a decision; it is refused instead of scored.

mmwave.neural_trust_reason: MMWAVE_M_N9_FULL_INT8_V1 is DEVICE_VALIDATED: NO / PI_SMOKE: NOT_PERFORMED, was trained on 337 public windows with mr60_used_for_calibration false, and on the committed 20260817 capture emits high-confidence APNEA-proxy over a signal carrying 82% of its power in the respiration band with a clean 20 rpm peak. Until a device smoke or retrain lands, the neural class is recorded but does not score. Set TRUSTED only after DEVICE_VALIDATED becomes true.

caution_formula.comment: WARNING is produced only by this formula after the room baseline locks, except vacant-room 5000 ppm which is demoted from emergency to caution. Occupied 5000 ppm stays emergency in the overall formula.
